body:
Phase 2, server. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md,
"Closing" and "The freeze rule".

- POST /lists/{id}/close-votes casts the caller's vote; if every CURRENT
  member has now voted, closed_at is set in the same transaction. DELETE
  withdraws. Both bump change_seq; both refuse a closed list (409
  list_closed). Former members do not count; a join raises the bar.
- Once closed: sync refuses item and list-field writes with 422 list_closed
  (+row_id); invite mint and redeem refused; leave allowed.
- Leave on an OPEN expense list: 409 list_open.
- The `deleted` tombstone on an expense list: 422 cannot_delete_expense_list.
- Freeze rule: frozen = voters + former members. Any write that would change
  a frozen participant's paid-by or paid-for amount is refused with 422
  participant_frozen {row_id, account_id}; new row = change from zero,
  deletion = change to zero. Checked against the field version that would
  WIN LWW — a stale loser must not be rejected.
- Account deletion unchanged (always allowed); the departed id stays in
  shares and is now frozen.
- wire-contract.md, server README, audit events for votes and closing.
- Tests: the vote state machine incl. join-raises-bar and former-member-
  does-not-count; every refusal; the freeze matrix (create/edit/delete ×
  voter/former) incl. the LWW-loser case; a solo list closing on one vote
  then leaving -> orphaned.
title: expenses: server — close votes, closed state, leave rule, freeze rule, no delete
